author: barnabasbusa
content:
1. Orphaned payloads: prysm builds before the inclusion lists are in. This is the cause.
- All 30 orphaned payloads since the fork were proposed by prysm, except one before the fork at slot 32. They are exactly the 30 block hashes that every ethrex node rejects with Payload does not satisfy its inclusion list.
- The other clients don't hit this: lighthouse, lodestar and teku have no orphans since the fork.
- Slot 396 (prysm-ethrex-2) as an example. Prysm asked its EL to start building at 11:25:37 UTC, the start of slot 395. The inclusion-list field in that request held one transaction. Prysm never sent another build request after the inclusion-list deadline, and fetched the payload at 11:25:46.
  - Inclusion lists for slot 396 keep arriving during slot 395 (prysm logs Received inclusion list ... slot=396). Transaction 0x216c4e2e… from those lists never made it into the payload.
  - ethrex on the node itself immediately flagged the payload as not satisfying its inclusion list. The other nodes treated it as missing and built the next block on top of the slot's block without its payload.
- Teku sends about twice as many forkchoiceUpdatedV5 calls (458 vs 224 in 15 minutes), which looks like it re-sends the build request with the final inclusion lists. Prysm doesn't.
- This hits both prysm nodes, so it's a prysm FOCIL timing bug, not config. A restart won't fix it.

author: barnabasbusa
content:
Code pointers at `b56dda97`:
- beacon-chain/blockchain/execution_engine.go:389: the IL txs (proposalInclusionListTransactions) are only read when payload attributes are computed for an FCU, i.e. on head update at the start of slot N−1, or in lateBlockTasks at AttestationDue (25%, 2.25s, see process_block.go:851). Both are before the IL deadline.
- Nothing re-sends the FCU with the final inclusion-list set at or after InclusionListDue for the next slot's proposer.
- beacon-chain/rpc/prysm/v1alpha1/validator/proposer_execution_payload.go:76-95: getLocalPayloadFromEngine reuses the cached payload ID and goes straight to GetPayload, without checking whether new inclusion lists arrived since that ID was created.
- Accepting lists works: inclusion_list.go:143 judges timeliness against InclusionListDue correctly.

Possible fix: when this node proposes the next slot, send a fresh FCU with the current inclusion lists at the IL deadline (or just before getPayload), or skip the cached payload ID when the inclusion-list set has changed. Teku makes about twice as many FCUs per slot as prysm, which suggests it already does the refresh.
